component.name: MujTerm
component.summary: Persistent project terminals with coding-agent status

description.p: MujTerm groups persistent terminal sessions by project and displays the current directory, Git branch, and Codex or Claude Code status.
Lets the window shrink again, fixes adding saved commands, adopts a calmer native look, and removes the service map, agent handoff and project timeline.
Suspends hidden VTE clients, bounds duplicate scrollback, and stops off-screen status animations.
Reduces Command Block polling, moves captures off the UI thread, and applies snapshots incrementally.
Adds private rotating logs, visible runtime errors, and safe database migrations with backups.
Starts VTE sessions asynchronously and splits the UI into focused modules.
Adds terminal input compatibility fixes and build diagnostics.
